title: finding(docs): `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` teaches the `ObjectRenderer` phantom in 3 blocks — third file, and `docs/**` is in no gate's scan surface
body:
Found while fixing the root README's three phantom imports for #7417. Out of that
card's file surface, so it is filed rather than edited.

Same phantom as #7095, **third file**. #7095 records it in
`examples/byo-backend-console/README.md`; #7417 recorded and has now fixed the root
`README.md`; this is the remaining occurrence.

## The defect

`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` teaches `ObjectRenderer` from `@object-ui/app-shell` in three
code blocks and two prose lines:

```
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:15    - `ObjectRenderer` - Renders object views
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:52    │  - ObjectRenderer                       │
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:154   import { AppShell, ObjectRenderer } from '@object-ui/app-shell';
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:161           ObjectRenderer objectName="contact"
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:184   import { ObjectRenderer } from '@object-ui/app-shell';
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:187   return ObjectRenderer objectName={params.object}
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:194   import { ObjectRenderer } from '@object-ui/app-shell';
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:204           ObjectRenderer objectName="contact"
```

(JSX angle brackets elided above; the file has them.)

`docs/CONSOLE-STREAMLINING-SUMMARY.md:17` repeats the claim in prose.

Measured against the built artifact on `origin/main` at `900f8d99`:
`grep Renderer packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts | grep export` returns **nothing** —
no export of `@object-ui/app-shell` bears that name, in any spelling.

## The correct spelling, and a trap in the obvious fix

⚠️ #7095 proposes *"The real export is `ObjectView` ... It takes `objectName`, so the
fix is a rename in place."* **A bare rename here would compile and still be wrong.**
`@object-ui/app-shell` does export an `ObjectView`, but:

- it takes **no** `objectName` prop — `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:865`
  is `export function ObjectView({ dataSource, objects, onEdit, externalRefreshKey }: any)`,
  and it reads `objectName` from `useParams()`, i.e. from a router route;
- it requires an `objects` metadata array, which the doc's snippets never supply, so
  it would throw or render "object not found";
- its whole props surface is typed `any` (#7483), so a wrong prop raises **nothing**
  at build time. The rename would look verified and be broken.

The spelling that actually works, and the one used in the #7417 fix, is
**`ObjectView` from `@object-ui/plugin-view`** — a real typed props surface
(`schema: ObjectViewSchema`, `dataSource: DataSource`), and the one
`examples/byo-backend-console/src/App.tsx` runs today.

## Why no gate caught it

The repo-root `docs/` tree is in **no** documentation gate's scan surface:

- `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` walks `content/docs` (its `DOCS_ROOT`), the
  per-app docs trees, `packages/NAME/README.md`, and the root `README.md`.
- `scripts/check-readme-exports.mjs` tracks `packages/NAME/README.md` only; its census
  on this tree prints `0 outside any package`.
- `lint:root` explicitly ignores `docs/**`.

So `docs/*.md` is an authored-docs directory that nothing reads. Whether that surface
should move is a separate question from fixing these eight lines.
